pages.text: namco WANGAN MIDNIGHT TECHNICAL BULLETIN We have become aware that some games are experiencing problems of a blank video screen or the game locking up. This problem is caused by the Power Supply fitted not maintaining the output voltage correctly. It is imperative that this Power Supply and Dongle are changed for the new Power Supply and Dongle supplied. The output voltage of the power supply must be between 4.95 ~ 5.00 volts. When checking or adjusting this voltage ensure that a good quality and accurate Digital Voltmeter is used.

Before commencing with these instructions ensure that the game is working correctly. Repair any faults and replace any faulty items. Switch the game off and disconnect from the power supply. 2.
